verdict.rationale: Fireflies exposes a GraphQL API (docs-5, docs-6, docs-16) that lets users programmatically fetch transcripts, analytics, and meeting data in structured JSON, which is a form of open-format data access, and also supports webhook/Zapier export pipelines. However, there is no documented one-click 'export all my data' or account-wide data portability/takeout feature, no mention of bulk export formats (CSV/JSON dump) covering all account data, and no explicit guidance for a user wanting to fully leave and take everything with them. Missing for 10: a documented full-account data export/takeout feature, explicit open-format bulk export tooling, and confirmation of complete data portability upon account closure.
